hero.lede: I'm {{ownerName}}, a software engineer in Mexico City. I've been in software since 2017, with more than 5 years of experience both as a fullstack developer and as a DevOps engineer. In recent years I've focused on automating deployments and building the tooling the development team needs to ship faster.
